reviewNotes: Route empresaId is selection only; SuscripcionesSaaSService resolves authoritative membership through IUsuarioScopeService and fails closed on absent/mismatched tenant.
Repository tenant-owned reads require EmpresaId; idempotency lookup is scoped by EmpresaId and IdempotencyKey and rechecks the returned subscription tenant.
Subscription persistence and idempotency ledger insertion execute in one transaction.
Onboarding replay is deterministic and rejects reuse of the same idempotency key with a different plan/start payload.
Controller returns stable 400 ProblemDetails when Idempotency-Key is absent and directed tests assert the code/title/detail contract.
No P0/P1 actionable defect was found in the reviewed BACKEND_API scope; broad unrelated workflows are noncausal unless an attributable failure is demonstrated.
